hypothesis: H75-1: 12-Azimuth Strike-Projected Fault-Tip & En-Echelon Relay-Bridge Kinematic Transfer Corroborated by 4-Domain Multi-Physics LOQO Ridges with Lake Lahontan Shoreline Mimic Gate and Sign-Corrected ComCat Seismic Density (D_eq)
mechanism: Fault tips and en-echelon relay step-overs concentrate off-fault Coulomb shear/dilatational damage along the local fault strike azimuth (projected across 12 x 15-deg tensor bins out to 2.7 km with a B=2.0 px collar ramp 1-exp(-(d_vis-2)/1.8)), while concealed basin/bedrock faults require >=2-domain corroboration across potential-field basement steps (D1), LiDAR/10m scarp asymmetry + chi/ksn knickzones (D2), GDR-1391 geothermometry + radiometric Th/K & U/K upflow (D3), and geodetic shear + sign-corrected seismic density D_eq (D4), decoded via d_min=2.85 px priority-ordered Poisson-disk packing (38,200 dots).
